2609.19137.title: Dreaming the Sound of Contact: Leveraging Video and Audio Generation for Zero-Shot Force-Aware Manipulation and Data Generation
2609.19137.paper_summary: Recent advances in video generation allow robots to learn manipulation trajectories from generated videos. However, these approaches produce purely kinematic trajectories that lack force information, causing failures in contact-rich tasks where appropriate contact forces are essential for success. In this work, we explore augmenting generated video with audio to shape a bounded, time-varying desired-force profile using the loudness of generated contact sounds. We present a pipeline that jointly leverages generated video and audio to derive motion trajectories and corresponding desired-force profiles from a structured natural-language task prompt. We execute these force-aware trajectories on a Franka Panda robot using a closed-loop force regulator that tracks the audio-shaped force profile during contact. We evaluate our pipeline on multiple tasks that require making contact and demonstrate successful manipulation where a kinematic-only baseline fails. We also use the pipeline as a data generation engine to train policies that achieve the tasks in a closed-loop manner. Project website, videos, and dataset: https://dreamingcontactsound.github.io/
2609.19137.paper_summary_zh: 最近在視頻生成方面的進展使得機器人能夠從生成的視頻中學習操作軌跡。<lb/>然而，這些方法產生的僅僅是運動學軌跡，缺乏力的資訊，這在需要適當接觸力才能成功的接觸豐富任務中會導致失敗。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們探討了如何利用音頻增強生成的視頻，以利用生成的接觸聲音的音量來塑造一個有界的、隨時間變化的期望力剖面。<lb/>我們提出了一個管道，該管道共同利用生成的視頻和音頻，從結構化的自然語言任務提示中推導出運動軌跡和相應的期望力剖面。<lb/>我們在一個Franka Panda機器人上執行這些考慮力的軌跡，使用一個閉環力調節器，在接觸過程中跟踪音頻塑造的力剖面。<lb/>我們在多個需要接觸的任務上評估了我們的管道，並展示了在運動學僅基準失敗的情況下成功的操作。<lb/>我們還將該管道用作數據生成引擎，以訓練能夠以閉環方式完成任務的策略。<lb/>項目網站、視頻和數據集：https://dreamingcontactsound.github.io/
